# Megan Warren

> Megan Warren is an independent educator, designer, and software builder based
> in Boston, Massachusetts. She takes custom software commissions and custom
> book commissions, and she coaches people 1:1 on using AI tools themselves.
> She is not the interior designer, the executive coach, or the wellness coach
> of the same name; this site is megan-warren.com.

Full detail, in flat declarative sentences: https://megan-warren.com/about/

## The plain facts

- Name: Megan Warren
- Location: Boston, Massachusetts, United States
- Works: remotely worldwide, in person around Boston
- Background: twelve years teaching and tutoring mathematics
- Site: https://megan-warren.com
- Source code: https://github.com/megwarren8
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/megan-warren-boston/

## What she offers

1. **Custom software commissions** (https://megan-warren.com/software/)
   Small, focused custom web tools and internal tools for classrooms,
   nonprofits, and small brands. Also brand systems delivered as offline
   documents, marketing sites, and design audits. Built offline first: one
   HTML file, zero network calls after it loads, no login and no install.
   Fixed price, most commissions between $1,500 and $10,000, quoted by scope
   and never by the hour. Tools of this size ship in one to three weeks.

2. **Custom book commissions** (https://megan-warren.com/books/)
   Interactive textbooks, course books, certification study guides, corporate
   onboarding guides, and training manuals. Each is one HTML file that opens
   in any browser with no wifi, login, or install. A single source forks into
   a student edition and a facilitator answer-key edition, so the two cannot
   drift apart. Print-ready layouts come from the same source. Same fixed
   price model; a full book usually sits in the upper half of the range.

3. **1:1 AI coaching** (https://megan-warren.com/coaching/)
   A free first conversation, then a short written game plan, then a guided
   practice session of 45 to 60 minutes where the client drives. $300 flat
   for the plan plus one session; extra sessions $150 each. In person within
   about five miles of downtown Boston, or remote by video call.

## What she does not take on

Enterprise software, projects needing a standing engineering team, and
open-ended work with no defined finish.

## Contact

Through the form on any page of https://megan-warren.com. Every inquiry is
read by Megan Warren herself; there is no agency, account manager, or
subcontractor involved in any commission.
